note: The FROZEN mutation gate corpus. Frozen BEFORE any scoring run over these suites: predictions below come from witness + divergence ANALYSIS, never from a score. Changing any pinned artifact after a scoring run voids the gates (a re-freeze + fresh run). MutationCorpusTest enforces the pins.
versionNote: v3 re-freeze, forced by a scorer change rather than a missed prediction: the relational dependence class re-reads the representative suite's rush relation (post rush:false, keep normalTotal, post rush:true, assert response.total > normalTotal) as a law between two same-operation responses whose requests differ on the axis rush, so its kill of REMOVE_CONDITIONALS@L70#0 now scores KILLED/independent where capture-reuse used to kill nothing. Only that representative prediction (moved from survivedHighlights to KILLED_independent, its reason under relationalKills) and this note changed; every suite, calc.js, provenance label and threshold is byte-identical to v2. The v2 record is superseded by a fresh official run against this v3 freeze, which also reports the capture-reuse reading (relations.captureReuseReading) — the v2 figure. History: v2 re-froze v1 after the v1 discrimination run missed on INLINE_CONSTANT@lookup.volumeTiers.1.discount, wrongly predicted smoke-NOTCOVERED (the smoke gold-EU row's qty 30 reads the lower volume band's rate).

anySuite.screenedWhy: the Discount cap arm is deliberately unreachable (max stack exactly 0.25): its arm-drop cannot fire, its boundary variant clamps to the same value, and a bigger cap is equally never exceeded. The approval-threshold boundary (>' -> '>=') screens out too: it diverges only at a total of EXACTLY 50000 — a boundary on a DERIVED value the enumerated deck cannot construct (the notderivable grey area) — reported with the deck's strength, never claimed equivalent

smoke.notCoveredWhy: no smoke scenario sends rush:true (the arm-entered witness L70#0:true never fires), and no smoke total quantity reaches the UPPER volume tier (>=50) — two rates no smoke request ever reads. The LOWER tier's rate IS read (the gold-EU row's qty 30 lands in [10,50)) — reached but unnoticed by a status-only suite: SURVIVED, not NOTCOVERED (the v1 prediction got this wrong; see versionNote)
smoke.SURVIVED: every other checked mutant (a status line cannot notice any pricing change)

relationalKills.REMOVE_CONDITIONALS@L70#0: the rush relation (response.total > normalTotal over two createOrder requests differing only on rush) is relational: dropping the surcharge arm makes both totals equal and the relation fails. Under the capture-reuse reading it survives

survivedHighlights.NEGATE_CONDITIONALS@L54#0: no representative row pins a discount value tightly enough to notice everyone getting the capped rate

representative.notCoveredWhy: no representative row's total quantity lands in the lower volume band, so the row-keyed arm-operand witness (minQty=10) never pairs — the lower tier's rate is never read by the suite

survivedWhy.INLINE_CONSTANT@lookup.tierDiscount.plat: no test would notice the platinum discount rate changing — the only platinum gold row also earns the volume tier, so the discount cap masks the rate
